form.label: Databricks Security - Threat detections
form.description: One panel per Databricks Security Reference Architecture (SRA) use case, from Databricks system tables: sensitive operations, behavioural detections (thresholds in the detection_rules view of the bundle), secrets, workspaces, IP addresses and ranges, unauthorized Unity Catalog requests, Delta Sharing and data usage. Source: refreshed tables (every 6 hours, up to 90 days) or the live audit log. Click a principal to filter on it.

search.query: | makeresults | addinfo | eval t_to=floor(if(isnum(info_max_time) AND info_max_time < now(), info_max_time, now())) | eval t_from=floor(max(info_min_time, now() - 90 * 86400)), range=t_to - t_from | eval t_span=case(range <= 7200, 60, range <= 43200, 300, range <= 172800, 900, range <= 691200, 3600, true(), 86400) | eval t_span_label=case(t_span == 60, "1m", t_span == 300, "5m", t_span == 900, "15m", t_span == 3600, "1h", true(), "1d")
| makeresults | eval v=$actor|s$ | eval v=if(len(trim(v)) == 0, "%", replace(replace(v, "['\"\\\\]", ""), "\*", "%"))
| makeresults | eval v="$sp$." . if("$source$" == "live", "live_", "")

| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT unix_timestamp(event_time) AS epoch, operation, severity, workspace_name, actor, action_name, target, left(detail, 200) AS detail, source_ip FROM $src$sensitive_operations WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND event_time >= timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AND event_time < timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR workspace_name = '$ws$') AND lower(coalesce(actor, '')) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 5000"

| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT unix_timestamp(window_start) AS epoch, detection_id, title, severity, principal, concat(array_join(slice(workspace_names, 1, 3), ', '), CASE WHEN size(workspace_names) > 3 THEN concat(' +', CAST(size(workspace_names) - 3 AS STRING), ' more') ELSE '' END) AS workspaces, events, distinct_objects, concat(array_join(slice(objects, 1, 3), ', '), CASE WHEN size(objects) > 3 THEN concat(' +', CAST(size(objects) - 3 AS STRING), ' more') ELSE '' END) AS objects, left(sample, 160) AS sample, concat(array_join(slice(source_ips, 1, 3), ', '), CASE WHEN size(source_ips) > 3 THEN concat(' +', CAST(size(source_ips) - 3 AS STRING), ' more') ELSE '' END) AS source_ips, sra_query FROM $src$security_detections WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND window_end > timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AND window_start < timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR array_contains(workspace_names, '$ws$')) AND lower(principal) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') ORDER BY severity_order, window_start DESC LIMIT 5000"

| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT activity, principal, count(DISTINCT event_date) AS days, sum(events) AS events, concat(array_join(slice(array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(objects))), 1, 4), ', '), CASE WHEN size(array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(objects)))) > 4 THEN concat(' +', CAST(size(array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(objects)))) - 4 AS STRING), ' more') ELSE '' END) AS sample_objects, size(array_distinct(flatten(collect_list(objects)))) AS distinct_objects_seen, concat(array_join(slice(array_sort(collect_set(workspace_name)), 1, 3), ', '), CASE WHEN size(array_sort(collect_set(workspace_name))) > 3 THEN concat(' +', CAST(size(array_sort(collect_set(workspace_name))) - 3 AS STRING), ' more') ELSE '' END) AS workspaces, left(max(sample), 160) AS sample, max(unix_timestamp(event_hour)) AS last_seen FROM $src$security_activity_hourly WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND event_hour >= date_trunc('HOUR', timestamp_seconds($t_from$)) AND event_hour < timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AND activity IN ('SECRET_READ', 'UC_DATA_DENIED', 'UC_DENIED', 'PRINT_STATEMENT') AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR workspace_name = '$ws$') AND lower(principal) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') GROUP BY activity, principal ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 5000"

| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT source_ip, ip_range, access_level, count(DISTINCT principal) AS principals, sum(events) AS events, sum(data_access_events) AS data_access_events, sum(failed_events) AS failed_events, concat(array_join(slice(array_sort(collect_set(principal)), 1, 3), ', '), CASE WHEN size(array_sort(collect_set(principal))) > 3 THEN concat(' +', CAST(size(array_sort(collect_set(principal))) - 3 AS STRING), ' more') ELSE '' END) AS sample_principals, count(DISTINCT workspace_id) AS workspaces, max(unix_timestamp(CAST(event_date AS TIMESTAMP))) AS last_seen FROM $src$access_footprint_daily WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND event_date <= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AS DATE) AND source_ip IS NOT NULL AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR workspace_name = '$ws$') AND lower(principal) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') GROUP BY source_ip, ip_range, access_level ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 5000"

| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT principal, principal_type, count(DISTINCT workspace_id) AS workspaces, count(DISTINCT event_date) AS days, sum(events) AS events, concat(array_join(slice(array_sort(collect_set(workspace_name)), 1, 4), ', '), CASE WHEN size(array_sort(collect_set(workspace_name))) > 4 THEN concat(' +', CAST(size(array_sort(collect_set(workspace_name))) - 4 AS STRING), ' more') ELSE '' END) AS sample_workspaces FROM $src$access_footprint_daily WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND event_date <= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AS DATE) AND workspace_id <> '0' AND lower(principal) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') GROUP BY principal, principal_type HAVING count(DISTINCT workspace_id) > 1 ORDER BY workspaces DESC, events DESC LIMIT 500"
| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT DISTINCT workspace_name FROM $sp$.workspaces WHERE workspace_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1"
| where detection_id!="PRINT_STATEMENTS" | stats count as v
| stats count(eval(severity="HIGH" OR severity="MEDIUM")) as v
| stats count as v
| stats count(eval(severity="HIGH")) as v
| stats dc(source_ip) as v
| stats count as v

panel.title: terms_of_service_changes — Terms of Service changes
panel.description: accounts.acceptTos / sendTos (account level).

search.query: | where operation="TERMS_OF_SERVICE" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as time | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval time="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: time, severity, workspace_name, actor, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: account_settings_changes — Account settings and account admin changes
panel.description: accounts.setSetting / deleteSetting at account level, setAccountAdmin, changeAccountOwner.

search.query: | where operation="ACCOUNT_SETTING" OR operation="ACCOUNT_ADMIN" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as time | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval time="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: time, severity, workspace_name, actor, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: global_init_script_changes — Global init script changes
panel.description: globalInitScripts.create / update / delete (name, enabled, script-SHA256).

search.query: | where operation="GLOBAL_INIT_SCRIPT" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as time | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval time="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: time, severity, workspace_name, actor, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: mount_point_creation — DBFS mount point creation
panel.description: dbfs.mount (mountPoint, source). Mounts bypass Unity Catalog.

search.query: | where operation="DBFS_MOUNT" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as time | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval time="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: time, severity, workspace_name, actor, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: repeated_access_to_secrets — Repeated access to secrets
panel.description: 10+ distinct secrets read by one principal in an hour (secrets.getSecret, scope/key).

search.query: | where detection_id="SECRET_ACCESS_BURST" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as window_start | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval window_start="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: window_start, principal, workspaces, events, distinct_objects, objects, sample, source_ips

panel.title: access_to_secrets — Access to secrets (selected period)
panel.description: Every principal reading secrets (secrets.getSecret): reads, secrets (scope/key) and workspaces.

search.query: | where activity="SECRET_READ" | eval last_seen=strftime(tonumber(last_seen), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval principal="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: principal, events, distinct_objects_seen, sample_objects, workspaces, days, last_seen

panel.title: access_to_multiple_workspaces — Access to multiple workspaces
panel.description: Principals active in more than one workspace (workspace = request_params.workspace_id for Unity Catalog events).

search.query: | head 500 | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval principal="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: principal, principal_type, workspaces, days, events, sample_workspaces

panel.title: use_of_print_statements — Use of print statements
panel.description: runCommand with print() in commandText: needs verbose audit logs on the workspace.

search.query: | where activity="PRINT_STATEMENT" | eval last_seen=strftime(tonumber(last_seen), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval principal="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: principal, events, sample_objects, sample, workspaces, last_seen

panel.title: ip_addresses_used_to_access_databricks — IP addresses used to access Databricks
panel.description: Client IPs of all audit events (source_ip_address, port removed); events issued by Databricks compute carry no client IP.

search.query: | stats sum(events) as requests sum(data_access_events) as data_access sum(failed_events) as failed max(principals) as principals values(access_level) as access first(sample_principals) as sample_principals max(last_seen) as last_seen by source_ip | sort - requests | eval last_seen=strftime(tonumber(last_seen), "%Y-%m-%d") | eval access=mvjoin(access, ", ") | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval source_ip="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: source_ip, access, requests, data_access, failed, principals, sample_principals, last_seen

panel.title: ip_address_ranges_used_to_access_databricks — IP address ranges (/24) used to access Databricks
panel.description: IPv4 /24 (IPv6 /48) networks of the client IPs.

search.query: | stats sum(events) as requests dc(source_ip) as ips max(principals) as principals values(access_level) as access max(last_seen) as last_seen by ip_range | sort - requests | eval last_seen=strftime(tonumber(last_seen), "%Y-%m-%d") | eval access=mvjoin(access, ", ") | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval ip_range="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: ip_range, access, ips, requests, principals, last_seen

panel.title: repeated_unauthorized_uc_requests — Repeated unauthorized Unity Catalog requests
panel.description: More than 25 Unity Catalog requests refused (status 401 / 403) in an hour.

search.query: | where detection_id="UC_DENIED_BURST" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as window_start | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval window_start="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: window_start, principal, workspaces, events, distinct_objects, objects, sample, source_ips

panel.title: repeated_unauthorized_uc_data_requests — Repeated unauthorized Unity Catalog data requests
panel.description: More than 15 refused generateTemporaryTable/Volume/PathCredential or deltaSharingQueryTable requests in an hour.

search.query: | where detection_id="UC_DATA_DENIED_BURST" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as window_start | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval window_start="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: window_start, principal, workspaces, events, distinct_objects, objects, sample, source_ips

panel.title: unauthorized_uc_data_requests — Unauthorized Unity Catalog data requests (selected period)
panel.description: Every refused data access request (401 / 403) per principal.

search.query: | where activity="UC_DATA_DENIED" | eval last_seen=strftime(tonumber(last_seen), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval principal="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: principal, events, distinct_objects_seen, sample_objects, workspaces, days, last_seen

panel.title: delta_sharing_recipients_without_ip_acls — Delta Sharing recipients created without IP access list
panel.description: unityCatalog.createRecipient / updateRecipient with authentication_type TOKEN and no ip_access_list.

search.query: | where operation="RECIPIENT_WITHOUT_IP_ACL" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as time | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval time="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: time, severity, workspace_name, actor, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: delta_sharing_ip_access_list_failures — Delta Sharing IP access list failures
panel.description: deltaSharingQueryTable / QueryTableChanges with is_ip_access_denied = true.

search.query: | where operation="SHARING_IP_DENIED" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as time | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval time="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: time, severity, workspace_name, actor, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: delta_sharing_recipient_token_lifetime_change — Delta Sharing recipient token lifetime change
panel.description: unityCatalog.updateMetastore with delta_sharing_recipient_token_lifetime_in_seconds.

search.query: | where operation="RECIPIENT_TOKEN_LIFETIME" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as time | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval time="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: time, severity, workspace_name, actor, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: most_popular_data_products — Most popular data products
panel.description: Reads and writes per table from lineage (system.access.table_lineage); refreshed tables only.

search.query: | eval last_access=strftime(tonumber(last_access), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval table_full_name="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: table_full_name, readers, reads, writers, writes, last_access

panel.title: databricks_access_to_customer_workspaces — Databricks support access to workspaces
panel.description: databricksAccess: approver, reason and duration in the detail.

search.query: | where operation="DATABRICKS_SUPPORT_ACCESS" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as time | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval time="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: time, severity, workspace_name, actor, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: install_library_on_all_clusters — Libraries installed on all clusters
panel.description: clusterLibraries.installLibraryOnAllClusters.

search.query: | where operation="LIBRARY_ON_ALL_CLUSTERS" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as time | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval time="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: time, severity, workspace_name, actor, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: other_behavioural_detections — Other behavioural detections
panel.description: repeated_failed_login_attempts, ip_access_list_failures, potential_privilege_escalation, data_downloads_from_control_plane, destructive_activities, high_number_of_read_writes, access_to_multiple_workspaces (5+ per day).

search.query: | where detection_id="FAILED_LOGIN_BURST" OR detection_id="IP_ACCESS_DENIED_BURST" OR detection_id="PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION" OR detection_id="DOWNLOAD_BURST" OR detection_id="DESTRUCTIVE_BURST" OR detection_id="READ_WRITE_BURST" OR detection_id="MULTI_WORKSPACE" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as window_start | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval window_start="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: window_start, title, principal, workspaces, events, distinct_objects, objects, sample

panel.title: host_security_alerts — Host security alerts (compliance security profile)
panel.description: clamAVScanService-dataplane and capsule8-alerts-dataplane events (compliance security profile only).

search.query: | where operation="ANTIVIRUS_DETECTION" OR operation="HOST_INTRUSION_ALERT" | eval epoch=strftime(tonumber(epoch), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | rename epoch as time | appendpipe [| stats count | where count=0 | eval time="No event in the selected period" | fields - count]

table.fields: time, severity, workspace_name, actor, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: Open-sharing recipients without IP access list (current)
panel.description: Current state (system.information_schema): TOKEN recipients with no IP access list.

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT recipient_name, shares_granted, share_names, token_expiration, recipient_owner, unix_timestamp(created) AS created_epoch FROM $sp$.delta_sharing_posture WHERE authentication_type = 'TOKEN' AND NOT has_ip_allowlist ORDER BY shares_granted DESC" | eval created=strftime(tonumber(created_epoch), "%Y-%m-%d") | fields - created_epoch

table.fields: recipient_name, shares_granted, share_names, token_expiration, recipient_owner, created
